meta.method: Route disruptions (current and planned, London-wide), one item per distinct text with the routes it names; kept when the text names a stop that lies in the zone on one of its routes (NaPTAN position), else when its opening "STREET, DISTRICT:" names a postcode district wholly in the zone (E1, E1W, E14, E16, EC3*, SE8, SE10, SE16); a borough name alone does not place it. Stop closures placed by the NaPTAN position of the stop (ATCO code), grouped by text and dates.
